cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Inspector to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards.
Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R.
Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products.
Generates Q.C. Documents as required.
Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts.
Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures.
Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established.
Maintains instrument calibration records.
Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups.
Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment.
Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection.
With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems.
Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures.
Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc.
May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to read and work with complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications
Experience performing mechanical and visual inspection of parts, subassemblies, and assemblies
Knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics
Ability to set up and operate standard inspection equipment including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, and sine blocks
Ability to perform setups, calibrations, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages
Ability to maintain calibration records and generate Q.C. Documents
Preferred Requirements
Experience with SPC and gage R&R
Experience with CNC first piece validation
Familiarity with liquid penetrant and visual inspection methods
Experience inspecting prototype products and working with engineers on inspection techniques
Experience with automating data collection in an inspection environment

cond_0020.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Inspector to join our team.
cond_0020.responsibilities: Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards. Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R. Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment. Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0020.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in mechanically inspecting a wide variety of mechanical/electrical products.
Proven track record setting up and operating complex measuring equipment, including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, and sine blocks.
Advanced knowledge of blueprints, assembly prints, and production specifications.
Deep knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics sufficient to diagnose malfunctions or failures in inspection setups.
Strong command of calibration processes, including setups, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Expertise in performing functional and dimensional inspection of precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in SPC and gage R&R methodologies.
Solid understanding of CNC first piece validation processes.
Expertise in liquid penetrant and visual inspection techniques.
Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical abilities when devising gauging or measuring setups for new or unusual parts.
Ability to work independently with engineers to develop inspection techniques and procedures for prototype products.

cond_0069.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Inspector to join our team.
cond_0069.responsibilities:
Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards.
Regularly works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R.
Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products.
Generates Q.C. Documents as required.
Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts.
Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures.
Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established.
Maintains instrument calibration records.
Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups.
Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment.
Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection.
With vendor supplied and manufactured product; actively communicates with Inspection and Production Supervisor to flag and resolve quality problems.
Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works directly with engineers to clarify and devise best inspection techniques and procedures.
Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc.
May be called upon to perform production testing.

Ability to work with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications.
Experience performing complex mechanical and dimensional inspections on a wide variety of parts and products.
Familiarity with inspection equipment including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks and similar tools.
Knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics sufficient to diagnose malfunctions or failures in inspection setups.
Ability to devise gauging or measuring setups and adapt inspection equipment or fixtures as needed.
Experience with instrument calibration, adjustments and repairs.
Ability to prepare reports, summary sheets, calculations and graphs.
Comfortable communicating regularly with QA engineering, production supervisors and engineers to clarify requirements and resolve quality issues.
Experience with SPC and gage R&R is an asset.
Experience inspecting prototype products and working with engineers to develop inspection techniques is an asset.

Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R. Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment. Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0174.requirements: Responsible for mechanically inspecting a wide variety of mechanical/electrical products and the setting up of a wide variety of measuring equipment to verify product, material and equipment conformance/customer specifications. Relevant experience in a similar inspection or quality control role is valued, and an equivalent combination of education and hands-on training is considered. Familiarity with blueprints, assembly prints, and production specifications is helpful; you don't need to have seen every type before. Working knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics is useful for diagnosing issues in inspection setups. Comfort with standard inspection equipment — including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar tools — is expected, though you can build confidence with specific equipment on the job. Exposure to SPC, gage R&R, and calibration processes is a plus. Ability to generate clear documentation and reports. Willingness to learn new inspection techniques and work collaboratively with engineers and production staff. Openness to feedback and a methodical approach to problem-solving are qualities we look for.
cond_0174.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.

Own the mechanical inspection of a wide variety of mechanical/electrical products. Set up and operate measuring equipment to verify product, material, and equipment conformance to customer specifications.
Work with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications to visually and mechanically inspect parts, subassemblies, and assemblies across all [Company name masked] products, ensuring conformance to production specifications and quality standards. Drive QA engineering inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC, and gage R&R. Execute first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Lead the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor, or bench inspections on a wide variety of parts and products. Generate Q.C. Documents as required. Determine the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plan, set up, and execute the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Perform functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintain instrument calibration records. Perform setups, calibrations, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Apply knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose the cause of any malfunctions or failures in inspection setups. Set up and operate all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic, sine blocks, and other similar equipment. Prepare reports and summary sheets; make calculations and plot graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor-supplied and manufactured product, notify Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Carry out necessary inspection of prototype products and, on occasion, work with engineers to determine the best inspection techniques and procedures. Perform and record results from liquid penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0197.requirements: Ability to work with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications. Experience performing complex mechanical and dimensional inspections. Familiarity with inspection equipment including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar tools. Knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics. Ability to devise gauging or measuring setups and adapt inspection equipment or fixtures. Experience with instrument calibration, adjustments, and repairs. Ability to generate Q.C. Documents, reports, and summary sheets. Experience with SPC and gage R&R. Ability to perform liquid penetrant and visual inspection. Experience with first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
cond_0197.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0197.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with inspection techniques and precision measurement work.
cond_0230.responsibilities: Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards. Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R. Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. cond_0240.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Inspector to join our team.
cond_0240.responsibilities:
Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards.
Works closely with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R — regularly communicating progress and findings.
Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products.
Generates Q.C. Documents as required.
Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts.
Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures.
Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established.
Maintains instrument calibration records.
Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups.
Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment.
Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection.
With vendor supplied and manufactured product, actively notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems, initiating follow-up as needed.
Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works directly with engineers to discuss and devise best inspection techniques and procedures.
Performs and records results from liquid penetrant, visual inspection, etc.
May be called upon to perform production testing.

Coordinates with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC, and gage R&R.
Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
Conducts incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor, and bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products.
Generates Q.C. Documents as required.
Determines appropriate methods for inspecting new or unusual parts.
Plans, sets up, and performs complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and adapting inspection equipment or fixtures.
Performs functional and dimensional inspection of complex precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges to verify conformance to applicable specification standards.
Maintains instrument calibration records.
Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Applies shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose malfunctions or failures in inspection setups.
Sets up and operates standard inspection equipment including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar equipment.
Prepares reports and summary sheets; calculates and plots graphs showing acceptance and rejection rates.
Documents quality problems with vendor-supplied and manufactured product and reports findings to Inspection and Production Supervisor.

cond_0300.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Inspector to join our team.
cond_0300.responsibilities: Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards. Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R. Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment. Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0300.requirements: Responsible for mechanically inspecting a wide variety of mechanical/electrical products and the setting up of a wide variety of measuring equipment to verify product, material and equipment conformance/customer specifications. Relevant experience in a similar inspection or quality control role is valued, and an equivalent combination of education and hands-on training is considered. Familiarity with blueprints, assembly prints, and production specifications is helpful; you don't need to have seen every type before. Working knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics is useful for diagnosing issues in inspection setups. Comfort with standard inspection equipment — including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar tools — is expected, though you can build confidence with specific equipment on the job. Exposure to SPC, gage R&R, and calibration processes is a plus. Ability to generate clear documentation and reports. Willingness to learn new inspection techniques and work collaboratively with engineers and production staff. Openness to feedback and a methodical approach to problem-solving are qualities we look for.

Work with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications to visually and mechanically inspect parts, subassemblies, and assemblies across all [Company name masked] products, ensuring conformance to production specifications and quality standards. Drive QA engineering inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC, and gage R&R. Execute first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Lead the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor, or bench inspections on a wide variety of parts and products. Generate Q.C. Documents as required. Determine the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plan, set up, and execute the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Perform functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintain instrument calibration records. Perform setups, calibrations, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Apply knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose the cause of any malfunctions or failures in inspection setups. Set up and operate all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic, sine blocks, and other similar equipment. Prepare reports and summary sheets; make calculations and plot graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor-supplied and manufactured product, notify Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Carry out necessary inspection of prototype products and, on occasion, work with engineers to determine the best inspection techniques and procedures. Perform and record results from liquid penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0323.requirements: Ability to work with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications. Experience performing complex mechanical and dimensional inspections. Experience with instrument calibration, adjustments, and repairs. Ability to generate Q.C. Documents, reports, and summary sheets. Experience with SPC and gage R&R. Ability to perform liquid penetrant and visual inspection. Experience with first piece validation of CNC generated parts.

Coordinate with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R.
Support first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
Work with the Inspection and Production Supervisor to address quality problems on vendor-supplied and manufactured products.
Perform incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor, or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products.
Generate Q.C. Documents as required.
Help determine the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts.
Plan, set up, and perform complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures.
Perform functional and dimensional inspection of precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges to verify conformance to applicable specification standards.
Maintain instrument calibration records.
Perform setups, calibrations, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Apply shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose causes of malfunctions or failures in inspection setups.
Set up and operate standard inspection equipment including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar equipment.
Prepare reports, summary sheets, calculations, and graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection.
Collaborate with engineers on prototype product inspection to help devise appropriate inspection techniques and procedures.
Perform and record results from liquid penetrant, visual inspection, and similar methods.
May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0333.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to read and work with complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications
Experience performing mechanical and dimensional inspections on a variety of parts and products
Ability to set up and operate standard inspection equipment (e.g., optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, sine blocks)
Knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics
Ability to maintain calibration records and perform calibrations, adjustments, and repairs on instruments and gages
Preferred Requirements
Experience with SPC and gage R&R processes
Familiarity with automating data collection in inspection systems
Experience inspecting prototype products
Experience with liquid penetrant and ultrasonic inspection methods
Ability to devise gauging or measuring setups for new or unusual parts

cond_0385.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Inspector to join our team.
cond_0385.responsibilities:
Inspects parts, subassemblies, and assemblies against production specifications and quality standards using complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications.
Coordinates with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC, and gage R&R.
Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
Conducts incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor, and bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products.
Generates Q.C. Documents as required.
Determines appropriate methods for inspecting new or unusual parts.
Plans, sets up, and performs complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and adapting inspection equipment or fixtures.
Performs functional and dimensional inspection of complex precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges to verify conformance to applicable specification standards.
Maintains instrument calibration records.
Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Applies shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose malfunctions or failures in inspection setups.
Sets up and operates standard inspection equipment including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar equipment.
Prepares reports and summary sheets; calculates and plots graphs showing acceptance and rejection rates.
Documents quality problems with vendor-supplied and manufactured product and reports findings to Inspection and Production Supervisor.
Inspects prototype products and, when required, coordinates with engineering to determine appropriate inspection techniques and procedures.
Performs and records results from liquid penetrant, visual inspection, and similar methods.
May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0385.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ability to read and work from complex blueprints, assembly prints, and specifications.
Experience performing mechanical and dimensional inspection of parts and assemblies.
Proficiency setting up and operating standard inspection equipment including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, and similar tools.
Knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics.
Ability to maintain calibration records and perform calibrations, adjustments, and repairs on instruments and gages.
Ability to generate inspection documents, reports, and summary sheets.
Preferred Requirements:
Experience with SPC and gage R&R processes.
Familiarity with automating data collection in an inspection environment.
Experience inspecting prototype products.
Experience with liquid penetrant and visual inspection methods.
Ability to devise gauging or measuring setups for new or unusual parts.

Coordinates with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R.
Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts.
Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products.
Generates Q.C. Documents as required.
Works with the team to determine the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts.
Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures.
Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to help determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established.
Maintains instrument calibration records.
Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to help diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups.
Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment.
Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection.
With vendor supplied and manufactured product, keeps Inspection and Production Supervisor informed of quality problems.
Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineers to devise best inspection techniques and procedures.
Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc.
May be called upon to perform production testing.

cond_0442.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Inspector to join our team.
cond_0442.responsibilities: Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards. Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R. Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment. Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.

Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment. Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0452.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in mechanically inspecting a wide variety of mechanical/electrical products.
Proven track record setting up and operating complex measuring equipment, including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, and sine blocks.
Advanced knowledge of blueprints, assembly prints, and production specifications.
Deep knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics sufficient to diagnose malfunctions or failures in inspection setups.
Strong command of calibration processes, including setups, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages.
Expertise in performing functional and dimensional inspection of precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in SPC and gage R&R methodologies.
Solid understanding of CNC first piece validation processes.
Expertise in liquid penetrant and visual inspection techniques.
Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical abilities when devising gauging or measuring setups for new or unusual parts.
Ability to work independently with engineers to develop inspection techniques and procedures for prototype products.

Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R. Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment. Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0462.requirements: Responsible for mechanically inspecting a wide variety of mechanical/electrical products and the setting up of a wide variety of measuring equipment to verify product, material and equipment conformance/customer specifications. Relevant experience in a similar inspection or quality control role is valued, and an equivalent combination of education and hands-on training is considered. Familiarity with blueprints, assembly prints, and production specifications is helpful; you don't need to have seen every type before. Working knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics is useful for diagnosing issues in inspection setups. Comfort with standard inspection equipment — including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar tools — is expected, though you can build confidence with specific equipment on the job. Exposure to SPC, gage R&R, and calibration processes is a plus. Ability to generate clear documentation and reports. Willingness to learn new inspection techniques and work collaboratively with engineers and production staff. Openness to feedback and a methodical approach to problem-solving are qualities we look for.

cond_0515.responsibilities: Working with the most complex blueprints, assembly prints and specifications, visually and mechanically inspects parts, subassemblies and assemblies on all company products to ensure conformance to production specifications and quality standards. Works with QA engineering on inspection system projects such as automating data collection, implementing SPC and gage R&R. Performs first piece validation of CNC generated parts. Performs the most complex incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor or bench inspection on a wide variety of parts and products. Generates Q.C. Documents as required. Determines the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Plans, sets up and performs the most complex mechanical inspections by devising necessary gauging or measuring setups and/or making adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures. Performs functional and dimensional inspection of various types of complex precision measuring instruments, tools and gauges to determine conformance to applicable specification standards where procedures and methods of inspection may or may not be established. Maintains instrument calibration records. Performs setups, calibrations, adjustments and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Uses knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics to diagnose cause of any malfunctions or failure in inspection set ups. Sets up and operates all standard inspection equipment as well as optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machine, ultrasonic, sine blocks and other similar equipment. Prepares reports, summary sheets and makes calculations and plots graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. With vendor supplied and manufactured product; notifies Inspection and Production Supervisor of quality problems. Performs necessary inspection of prototype products and on occasion works with engineer to devise best inspection techniques and procedures. Performs and records results from liquid Penetrant, visual inspection, etc. May be called upon to perform production testing.
cond_0515.requirements: Demonstrated expertise in mechanically inspecting a wide variety of mechanical/electrical products. Proven track record in setting up and operating complex measuring equipment to verify product, material and equipment conformance to customer specifications. Deep knowledge of blueprints, assembly prints, and production specifications. Advanced knowledge of shop theory and shop mathematics, with the ability to diagnose the cause of malfunctions or failures in inspection setups. Expertise in SPC, gage R&R, and inspection system projects including automated data collection. Strong command of all standard inspection equipment, including optical comparators, hardness testers, coordinate measuring machines, ultrasonic equipment, sine blocks, and similar instruments. Proficiency in performing functional and dimensional inspection of complex precision measuring instruments, tools, and gauges. Extensive experience performing incoming, first piece, in-process, final floor, and bench inspections on a wide variety of parts and products. Solid understanding of calibration procedures, with substantial experience performing setups, calibrations, adjustments, and repairs of complex instruments and gages. Exceptional attention to detail and strong ability to determine the best method of inspecting new or unusual parts. Ability to devise necessary gauging or measuring setups and make adaptations to inspection equipment or fixtures independently. Proficiency in preparing reports, summary sheets, calculations, and graphs indicating rates of acceptance and rejection. Expertise in liquid penetrant and visual inspection methods.
cond_0515.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0515.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.
